papers.title: OS-Omni: Benchmarking Generalist Computer-Using Agents on Long-Horizon Workflows Across Platforms
papers.desc: Computer-using agents are increasingly expected to complete realistic user goals rather than isolated GUI actions.

papers.title: What a Forecasting Leaderboard Can Establish: Resolution Reporting for Zero-Shot Time-Series Models
papers.desc: A foundation model for time series is pretrained once and then asked to forecast series it has never seen, so the evidence for it is its score on held-out datasets.

papers.title: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
papers.desc: Deep research agents gather information from multiple sources and synthesize it into reports on complex, open-ended questions.

papers.title: Boundary-Aware Policy Learning for Agent-Orchestrated Robot Manipulation
papers.desc: Agent-orchestrated robot systems combine the general reasoning capability of multimodal agents with the precise physical control of learned visuomotor policies.

papers.title: Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers
papers.desc: As large language models (LLMs) are used in more and more new tasks, context engineering becomes a fundamental method to efficiently steer LLMs by constructing instruction prompts or metadata without intensive training.

papers.title: When an AI agent makes a mistake in a database, what decides the damage?
papers.desc: AI agents now run statements against production databases, and several of the incidents that followed deleted production data, which came back only through backups or the provider's help.

papers.title: Damped Atomic Wave Integration Neurons (DAWIN): A Universal Primitive for Continuous-Time Spatiotemporal Learning
papers.desc: Conventional artificial neurons separate spatial feature aggregation from continuous physical time, limiting their ability to model irregular observations.

papers.title: BiSAT: Bidirectionally Aligned Semantic-Acoustic Tokenization for Speech Language Models
papers.desc: Speech language models (LMs) generate speech as sequences of discrete tokens.

papers.title: Guarding with Judgment: Learning to Intervene for Multimodal Safety
papers.desc: When visual context makes an ordinary request unsafe to answer as asked, a blanket refusal may leave the user's need unresolved.

papers.title: Generation as Reverse Encoding
papers.desc: Pretrained visual representations accelerate generative learning by abstracting away appearance and spatial detail.

papers.title: Reading, Not Adapting: Unlocking Frozen Visual Knowledge for AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.desc: Generalization to unseen image generators has driven efforts to adapt pretrained visual representations for detection.

papers.title: InitFree-SfM: When Initialization-Free Bundle Adjustment meets Learned Structure-from-Motion
papers.desc: Initialization-free bundle adjustment (InitFree BA) aims to jointly recover camera poses and scene structure without requiring an initial global estimate.

papers.title: Pretrained Tabular Features and the Measurement of Financial Proximity
papers.desc: Spatial arbitrage pricing theory (S-APT) extends factor models to allow returns to spill over between connected firms, beyond what common risk factors explain.

papers.title: Markdown Is Not a Firewall: four coding agents, one rules file, four boundaries
papers.desc: Teams put a one-page rules file in a repository and call it a control on coding agents.

papers.title: So Many Ways to Multiply 3times3 Matrices: A Large Dataset of Rank-23 Schemes
papers.desc: A publicly available dataset of 62029 rank-23 schemes for 3times3 matrix multiplication is presented.
